name: Trödlerstube
kurzbeschreibung:
**Antique & Curiosity Shop in St. Anton am Arlberg**

Step into the **Trödlerstube** in St. Anton am Arlberg, a charming treasure trove where time seems to stand still. This cozy spot is packed with vintage finds, quirky souvenirs, and handpicked local crafts—perfect for uncovering unique mementos of your Tyrolean adventure.

From retro ski gear to rustic wooden carvings, every corner holds a story. Browse through old postcards, traditional Tyrolean knick-knacks, and perhaps even a piece of **Kaiserschmarrn**-flavored nostalgia. Whether you're hunting for a special gift or just love the thrill of the hunt, the **Trödlerstube** is a must-visit for travelers with an eye for the extraordinary.

Open daily, this hidden gem is just a stone’s throw from the bustling heart of St. Anton—ideal for a quick detour between runs or a leisurely stroll through the village. Don’t leave without checking out their selection of **Tirol**-inspired trinkets and one-of-a-kind keepsakes!
